Full-stack application · file validation

Equipment Accounting Upload Portal

A controlled workflow for turning equipment workbooks and rate information into standardized, reviewable SAP-ready output.

  • RoleApplication design & development
  • TechnologyReact · FastAPI · SQLAlchemy · Azure SQL
  • ContextProfessional work at Graham

The problem

Accounting teams need to turn equipment timesheets and rate sheets into standardized upload files. Equipment classification, date-effective rates, source-hour inconsistencies, and exception handling make the work more than a file conversion task.

Approach

I built a portal that accepts equipment workbooks, analyzes source-hour data, presents warnings and stronger flags for review, and generates SAP-ready standby output. Its processing rules distinguish normal from forced generation and preserve the original and generated files.

Key decisions

  • Make business rules explicit before producing accounting data.
  • Separate reviewable warnings from stronger blocking flags.
  • Document processing decisions instead of embedding them only in spreadsheet formulas.
  • Limit access to verified and approved users.

What it demonstrates

Building a reliable human-review layer around complex accounting rules before automation produces an upload file.

Publication note

This describes documented code and a local workflow. It does not claim a current live deployment.
